title: Additional mount-out blocks ordered and packed

paragraphs.text: The landing team ordered additional mount-out blocks: thirty days of Class I, Class II spares for first through third echelon maintenance, dry cells, Class IV and Class V supplies, plus four days of Class III. Some blocks also had to be packed by the unit.
